questions.question: Use sort_bars with order equal to descending and use highlight_top_n with n equal to 2 in order to know What insights can be derived from the relationship between product importance, customer care calls, and discount offerings?

answer.value: The data reveals an interesting pattern: high-importance products receive the highest average discount (14.67), while low-importance products receive the lowest (13.04). There is also a clear inverse relationship between customer care calls and discounts - products with only 2 customer care calls average 16.77 discount, while those with 7 calls average only 6.46. This suggests that products requiring more customer support attention receive lower discounts, possibly as a cost-offsetting measure. High-importance products also have fewer average customer care calls (3.87) compared to low-importance products (4.11), indicating better customer satisfaction or fewer issues.

key_insights: High-importance products get highest discounts (14.67 avg)
Inverse relationship: more customer calls correlates with lower discounts (2 calls=16.77 discount
High-importance products have fewer customer care calls (3.87 avg vs 4.11 for low-importance)
Suggests quality products need less support and can offer better discounts
